---
title: Shortcodes
layout: docs
---


You might wonder what the difference is between a Hugo 'shortcode' and a Hugo 'brick'. Shortcodes place reusable content in an inline way, somewhere inside a section. Bricks are complete sections of a page. An example of a shortcode is a form; an example of a brick is a 'Call to action brick'.

Below you find a list of all shortcodes in this project:

- [blog](docs-shortcodes-blog.html) — the grid of post teasers with a tag filter
- [breadcrumbs](docs-shortcodes-breadcrumbs.html) — the trail from home to the current page
- [button](docs-shortcodes-button.html) — a call-to-action link; a plain link with the class 'button' does the same
- [cart](docs-shortcodes-cart.html) — the shopping cart table, total and progress bar
- [checkout](docs-shortcodes-checkout.html) — the checkout form with the progress bar
- [checkoutform](docs-shortcodes-checkoutform.html) — the same checkout form, without the progress bar
- [contactbuttons](docs-shortcodes-contactbuttons.html) — phone and email as icon buttons, from `data/<lang>/general.yaml`
- [contactform](docs-shortcodes-contact-form.html) — the contact form, fields from `data/<lang>/contactform.yaml`
- [ctaform](docs-shortcodes-cta-form.html) — the call-to-action form, fields from `data/<lang>/ctaform.yaml`
- [faq](docs-shortcodes-faq.html) — the question groups from `data/<lang>/faqs.yaml`
- [features](docs-shortcodes-features.html) — the grid of icon features from `data/<lang>/features.yaml`
- [gallery](docs-shortcodes-gallery.html) — a thumbnail grid of every image in a folder
- [newsletterform](docs-shortcodes-newsletterform.html) — a newsletter signup, fields from `data/<lang>/newsletterform.yaml`
- [openinghours](docs-shortcodes-openinghours.html) — `data/<lang>/openinghours.yaml` as a list of days and hours
- [pricing](docs-shortcodes-pricing.html) — the pricing table from `data/<lang>/pricing.yaml`
- [products](docs-shortcodes-products.html) — the grid of product cards
- [reviews](docs-shortcodes-reviews.html) — the testimonials from `data/<lang>/reviews.yaml`
- [search](docs-shortcodes-search.html) — a site search form that hands the query to Google
- [services](docs-shortcodes-services.html) — the grid of service teasers
- [socialbuttons](docs-shortcodes-socialbuttons.html) — the social links from `data/<lang>/footer.yaml`
- [tabs](docs-shortcodes-tabs.html) — runs of markdown behind a tablist, one tab per `## Heading`
- [team](docs-shortcodes-team.html) — the grid of people from `data/<lang>/people.yaml`
- [usecue-payment](docs-shortcodes-usecue-payment.html) — the embedded Usecue payment page
- [video](docs-shortcodes-video.html) — a self-hosted HTML5 video
- [vimeo](docs-shortcodes-vimeo.html) — a Vimeo poster linking out, no iframe and no cookies
- [youtube](docs-shortcodes-youtube.html) — a YouTube poster linking out, no iframe and no cookies

Some things that used to need a shortcode are plain markdown now. They have kept their page here, because the pattern is still worth documenting:

- [Map](docs-shortcodes-map.html)
- [Subpages](docs-shortcodes-subpages.html)
